purpose: Observe recurrent Jenkins CI readiness failures without altering published example code or accepting failed checks.

trigger.cause: Unconfirmed; pinned image alone did not prevent recurrence.

scope.httpTarget: Numeric 127.0.0.1 binding, /login only; no redirects or body read.

validation.method: Mocked Docker/HTTP failures, allowlist privacy, lifecycle, bounded history, command/environment/timeout preservation, original checker failure propagation.
validation.note: Real disposable-container execution is validated by the feature commit CI; local unit tests do not prove Docker startup.

review.method: Self AI code review; no independent or human review.
limits: Sampling may miss short-lived controllers or transitions.
Missing log flags do not disprove a problem; flags and OOM state alone do not establish failure causality.
Probe does not follow redirects and is not a replacement for the published urllib readiness assertion.
Locally concurrent newly started labs using the same name convention can also be observed.

publication: Review PR only; no automatic merge or publication of article or translation drafts.
